oracleCorrections.reason: The absent verifier predicate concerns client-local transaction-secret lifetime, not a protocol outcome message. RFC7636 sections 4.1 and 4.5 bind the verifier to its authorization request and code redemption; the selected profile disposes client scratch after successful redemption or cancellation, and creates none when the advertised S256 gate stops authorization. These existing source operations are the exact checkpoints; no synthetic outcome event or changed expected value is justified.

Current independent P6 review corrects actual operation identity, requested/granted scopes, Bearer challenges, refresh error domains and the original CIMD plan ordering. Proxy HTTP 200 carries an explicit MCP tool execution error, not protected output or a downstream renewal demand.

invariants.priorGrant: All failed new transactions retain prior read grant and historical disclosure; local disposal is actor-local and never implied revocation.
invariants.knowledge: Server decision precedes response delivery and client acceptance. Proxy-local refusal is returned over the existing protected request boundary, not installed as a client-local decision; upstream output must reach and be accepted by the proxy before it constructs the client result.
invariants.tls: Wire receipt acquires only a temporary ciphertext carrier, released at receiver-local TLS recovery. Recovery yields readable-untrusted application objects; local validation creates accepted context. A later wire receipt neither adds an inner plaintext copy nor erases a readable copy retained from an earlier recovered request.
invariants.secrets: Verifier C->A only; refresh C->A only; browser cookie B/A only; upstream token P/U only.
invariants.policy: tokenAccepted, hostInvocationApproved, resourceAuthorized, operationExecuted and resultLearned are independent.
